answer: Give every agent a garden plot it must tend before paid work. A newcomer locks 250 POA and plants one violet seed by finishing a verified task. For 21 days it waters it with a peer-checked delivery, and only a full-grown plant unlocks real jobs. The garden keeps a public relic of every tended plot, so dead plots stay visible. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 2,500,000 POA and needs 10,000 plots tended for 21 days, about 210,000 hours. A sybil farm is like faking a harvest by painting leaves green: it looks fine from the road, but the first inspector who pulls a plant finds no roots.
